UnitStatement: Exports type SdkMessageMapping with uiEvents (UIEvent[]), harnessEvents (HarnessEvent[]), optional sdkSessionId and sdkClaudeCodeVersion.
Exports type SdkToolEvidenceState tracking toolNamesByUseId (Map<string,string>) and startedToolUseIds (Set<string>).
createSdkToolEvidenceState() returns a fresh SdkToolEvidenceState with empty Map and Set.
readSessionId reads a message's session_id string field; readMessageId reads its uuid field.
isSdkBuiltinEvidenceDescriptor treats a descriptor as evidence-bearing only when surface is 'claude-agent-sdk-builtin' and it has read, workspace-write, or shell permission.
isChiralityMcpTool returns true when the tool's descriptor surface is 'chirality-mcp' or the tool name is a Chirality MCP allowed tool name.
registerQueuedToolUse records a toolUseId->toolName mapping in the evidence state when both are present.
createInferredToolStartedEvent emits a single 'tool.started' event per toolUseId, deduplicating via startedToolUseIds so a start is inferred at most once.
readToolUsesFromContent extracts tool-use evidence from content blocks of type 'tool_use' or 'server_tool_use', returning id, name, and input.
sdkEvidence builds redacted adapter evidence (adapterName 'claude-agent-sdk', adapter/sdk session and message ids) merged with extra data.
mapSdkUserToolResultEvents emits tool lifecycle events from tool_use_result only when the tool is a known SDK builtin evidence descriptor and not a Chirality MCP tool.
A tool_use_result is mapped to 'tool.failed' when isToolResultFailure is true, otherwise 'tool.completed'.
Shell-descriptor tool results additionally attach summarizeShellResultStreams metadata.
mapSdkUserMessage emits a user 'message.completed' event and enqueues a 'queue.enqueued' event when shouldQuery is false or priority is 'next'/'later'.
isSystemInit/isCompactBoundary/isPermissionDenied/isMirrorError are type guards keyed on message.type 'system' and the respective subtype.
Exports mapSdkMessageToHarness(sessionId, message, state) which dispatches SDK messages to UI and harness events by message type.
A system 'init' message yields a 'session:init' UI event and an 'adapter.initialized' harness event carrying model, tools, mcpServers, and permissionMode.
A 'stream_event' message yields 'chat:delta' UI events for text deltas and 'model.delta'/'message.delta' harness events, plus 'tool.queued' for streamed tool_use starts.
An 'assistant' message yields 'chat:delta' for text and 'message.completed' plus per-tool 'tool.queued' harness events.
A successful 'result' message yields 'chat:complete', 'session:complete', and 'process:exit' (exitCode 0) UI events plus 'model.completed' and 'turn.completed' harness events.
A successful result with deferred_tool_use registers the deferred tool and emits a 'tool.queued' harness event with queueReason 'deferred_tool_use'.
A failed 'result' yields a 'process:exit' UI event with exitCode 1, errorType 'SDK_FAILURE', status 500, fatal true, and a 'turn.failed' harness event.
A permission_denied message yields a 'tool:result' UI event (ok false) and both 'tool.permission' (deny) and 'tool.failed' (failureSource 'permission') harness events.
A compact_boundary message yields a 'context.compacted' harness event with replayImplication 'sdk_transcript_linkage_required'.
A 'tool_progress' message emits an inferred 'tool.started' for SDK builtin evidence descriptors plus a 'tool.progress' harness event with elapsed time and taskId.
A 'tool_use_summary' emits a 'tool.completed' harness event unless every preceding tool use was a Chirality MCP tool, in which case no event is emitted.
hook_started/hook_progress/hook_response system subtypes map to hook.started/hook.progress and hook.completed-or-failed harness events.

A system 'status' message maps status 'requesting' to model.request.started, 'compacting' to context.compaction.started, and compact_result success/failed to context.compacted/context.compaction.failed.
task_started/task_progress/task_updated/task_notification system subtypes map to subagent.started/progress/completed/failed harness events.
task_updated maps patch.status 'completed' to subagent.completed, 'failed'/'killed' to subagent.failed, otherwise subagent.progress.
Unrecognized message types yield empty uiEvents and harnessEvents arrays (no-op fallthrough).
Exports type SdkProbeOptions extending SDK Options with a required settingSources: SettingSource[].
parseSettingSources returns ['project'] only when the raw env value is exactly the single token 'project', otherwise an empty array.

mapPermissionMode maps normalized 'readOnly'/'dontAsk' to 'dontAsk', 'workspaceWrite' to 'acceptEdits', and 'bypass' (only when CHIRALITY_ALLOW_SDK_BYPASS==='1') to 'bypassPermissions', else 'default'.
contentBlocksToPrompt appends a text/attachment summary to the message; file blocks render as '[Attachment: <path> (<mimeType>)]'.
Exports buildSdkPrompt(message, contentBlocks) which delegates to contentBlocksToPrompt.
Exports buildSdkOptions which resolves the tool pool, derives allowed Chirality MCP tool names, and assembles SDK Options.
buildSdkOptions sets cwd to session.projectRoot, applies tools/allowedTools/disallowedTools from the resolved pool, and wires canUseTool, hooks, and Chirality read MCP servers.
buildSdkOptions sets resume to session.sdkSessionId and systemPrompt as a preset 'claude_code' with the supplied systemPrompt appended.
Session event files live under CHIRALITY_SESSION_ROOT or <cwd>/.chirality/sessions, with per-session events.jsonl.
appendHarnessEvent creates the session directory and appends a redacted JSON line to events.jsonl, returning the file path.
replayHarnessEvents reads events.jsonl, parses each non-empty line as a HarnessEvent, and returns events plus a malformedLineCount; a missing file yields empty events.
Default persona is 'WORKING_ITEMS' and default mode is 'direct' for new sessions.

assertProjectRootAccessible requires an absolute path, rejects roots inside the instruction root (WORKING_ROOT_CONFLICT 409), and verifies the directory exists and is R/W accessible (WORKING_ROOT_INACCESSIBLE 404).
readSessionFromDisk reads <sessionId>.json and throws SESSION_NOT_FOUND (404) when the file is missing or unparseable.
Exports FileSessionManager implementing ISessionManager with filesystem-backed session storage.
FileSessionManager.create assigns a sessionId of 'sess_'+randomUUID, sets createdAt/updatedAt, and writes the session JSON.
FileSessionManager.save merges updates while preserving sessionId and createdAt and refreshing updatedAt.
FileSessionManager.list returns sessions whose resolved projectRoot matches the requested root, sorted ascending by createdAt, ignoring malformed records.
Exports type GovernanceGateId enumerating gates: ENVIRONMENT, PERSONA_ALLOWLIST, METADATA_PRESENCE, CONTEXT_SEALED, PIPELINE_RUN_APPROVED, APPROVAL_REF, INTERNAL_ERROR, ALLOW.
Exports type SubagentGovernanceDecision with allowed, gate, reason, evaluationMs, allowlistedSubagents, delegatedSubagents, and optional approvalRef/approvedBy.
resolveDelegatedSubagents rejects candidate subagents whose instruction file is missing or whose AGENT_TYPE is not 2, and warns (but allows) when AGENT_CLASS is not 'TASK'.
Exports async evaluateSubagentGovernance(persona, subagentGovernance, env) returning a fail-closed SubagentGovernanceDecision.
Governance denies at ENVIRONMENT gate unless env.CHIRALITY_ENABLE_SUBAGENTS === 'true'.
Governance denies at PERSONA_ALLOWLIST gate when the persona's frontmatter lists no allowlisted subagents.
Governance denies at CONTEXT_SEALED gate unless subagentGovernance.contextSealed is strictly true, and at PIPELINE_RUN_APPROVED unless pipelineRunApproved is strictly true.
Governance denies at APPROVAL_REF gate unless subagentGovernance.approvalRef is a non-empty string.
On passing all gates, governance returns allowed=true gate 'ALLOW' with resolved delegatedSubagents, approvalRef, and approvedBy.
Any thrown error during evaluation is caught and converted to an INTERNAL_ERROR deny decision (fail-closed).
logDecision logs an ALLOW or DENY line with persona, gate, and evaluationMs; maybeWarnOnSlowEvaluation warns when evaluationMs exceeds CHIRALITY_SUBAGENT_GOVERNANCE_WARN_MS.
Exports HARNESS_TOOL_REGISTRY_VERSION = 'harness-tools.v5.bash'.
Exports type ClaudeAgentSdkBuiltinToolName union: Read, Glob, Grep, LS, Write, Edit, MultiEdit, NotebookEdit, Bash, WebFetch, WebSearch, Agent.
Exports type HarnessToolPermission union: read, workspace-write, network, shell, subagent, danger.
Exports HarnessToolPathScope union: none, project-root-read, project-root-write, instruction-root-read, external-network.
HarnessToolHumanGate is either {required:false} or {required:true, gate, reason} with gate in interactive-confirmation | approval-sha | future-policy.

Exports type HarnessToolDescriptor capturing name, aliases, surface, permissions, pathScope, idempotence, concurrency, interruptBehavior, resultBudget, provenance, humanGate, adapter, schemas, and runtime support.
Read result budget is 64KiB inline / 2MiB artifact; write budget 16KiB inline / 512KiB artifact; shell budget 16KiB inline / 2MiB artifact; all overflow to artifact.
readOnlyDescriptor factory builds read-permission SDK-builtin descriptors (project-root-read, idempotent, safe concurrency, no human gate, SDK_READ_RUNTIME).
chiralityReadMcpDescriptor factory builds read-only chirality-mcp descriptors, adding the MCP tool name and its allowed form to aliases.
Exports HARNESS_TOOL_DESCRIPTORS registering read_file/find_files/search_files/list_files (SDK read) and status_read/deps_read/scope_scan/scaffold_preview (Chirality read MCP).
write_file, edit_file, and multi_edit_file are workspace-write, mutating, serialized-by-path, block-on-interrupt descriptors requiring an interactive-confirmation human gate.
notebook_edit is a 'reserved' surface (workspace-write+danger) gated behind future-policy and not exposed to the model (DESCRIPTOR_ONLY_RUNTIME).
The 'shell' (Bash) descriptor carries permissions shell+workspace-write+danger, exclusive concurrency, and requires an interactive-confirmation human gate.
web_fetch and web_search are reserved network descriptors gated behind future-policy and not exposed to the model under the Anthropic-only runtime policy.
The 'agent' (subagent) descriptor has permission 'subagent', emits subagent lifecycle events, and is gated behind future-policy (descriptor-only).
createDescriptorLookup builds a case-insensitive Map keyed by descriptor name, each alias, and the SDK tool name.
Exports listHarnessToolDescriptors, getHarnessToolDescriptor (by normalized name/alias), and getKnownHarnessToolNames.
getCurrentTrancheDisallowedToolNames returns every descriptor's SDK tool name not present in the allowed set.
Exports resolveHarnessToolPool which resolves requested tools to descriptors, evaluates permission decisions, and partitions into allowed, disallowed, denied, and unknown tools.

A requested tool joins allowedToolNames only when its permission decision is 'allow', the descriptor is exposedToModel, and it has an SDK tool name; otherwise it is recorded as DENIED_BY_CURRENT_PHASE.
SAFE_PATH_FIELD_NAMES whitelists file_path, path, deliverablePath, executionRoot, decompositionPath, projectRoot for evidence capture.
Exports type ToolInputEvidence (inputType, inputKeys, pathFields) and ToolResultEvidence with byte lengths, content types, budget limits, and a budgetClass.
Exports type ToolResultBudgetClass: unknown-descriptor, within-inline-budget, requires-artifact-overflow, exceeds-artifact-budget.
Exports type ShellResultStreamEvidence describing stdout/stderr presence and byte lengths, interruption, background-task, and sandbox flags.
classifyResultBudget compares result byte length against the descriptor's inline and artifact limits to assign a ToolResultBudgetClass; no descriptor yields 'unknown-descriptor'.
summarizeToolInput returns inputType, sorted inputKeys, and redacted pathFields restricted to the safe path field whitelist.

summarizeToolResult computes result byte length, content item count, content text byte length, distinct content types, and budget classification; it never persists output (outputPersisted/rawOutputPersisted false).
summarizeShellResultStreams reports stdout/stderr presence and byte lengths and flags backgroundTask, interrupted, isImage, rawOutputPathPresent, and dangerouslyDisableSandbox.
summarizeToolDescriptor projects a descriptor to name, adapter tool name, surface, permissions, pathScope, humanGate, and resultBudget.
summarizeToolError normalizes Error instances and record-like errors into a redacted {errorName, message, type, status}.
isToolResultFailure returns true when a record result has is_error===true or isError===true.
Exports HarnessToolPathPolicyResult as a discriminated union of allowed (with allow metadata) and denied (with reason and metadata).
PRIMARY_PATH_FIELDS scans file_path, path, notebook_path, deliverablePath, executionRoot, decompositionPath for the path subject.
isWithinRoot returns true when the candidate resolves to or under the root (relative path is empty or non-'..' and not absolute).
resolveToolPath resolves absolute raw paths directly and relative paths against the project root.
rejectSymlinkWritePath walks each path segment from the project root and denies (symlink-write) if any component is a symbolic link.
A missing project root segment yields project-root-missing deny; deeper ENOENT segments are allowed (path not yet created).
Exports async evaluateToolPathPolicy which denies a pre-blocked SDK path, allows tools without project-root read/write scope, and enforces containment for scoped tools.
A resolved path outside the active project root is denied with denyClass 'path-containment'.
For write-scope tools, paths under the instruction root are denied (instruction-root) and symlink-crossing write paths are rejected before allowing.
Exports type ToolResultArtifactMetadata with artifactPath, artifactRelativePath, byte lengths, redacted:true, and truncated flag.
persistToolResultArtifact only persists when the descriptor budget overflow is 'artifact'; returns undefined otherwise.
An artifact is written only when the redacted serialized result exceeds the descriptor's inline byte limit.
Results exceeding the artifact byte limit are persisted truncated, storing only a preview sliced to the inline byte limit plus originalByteLength.
Tool result artifacts are written under <sessionRoot>/<sessionId>/artifacts/tools/<toolUseId>-<toolName>.json with sanitized path segments.
Exports HARNESS_SHELL_POLICY_VERSION='harness-shell.v1.bash', DEFAULT_BASH_TIMEOUT_MS=120000, MAX_BASH_TIMEOUT_MS=600000.
NETWORK_COMMANDS denylist covers curl, ftp, nc, netcat, rsync, scp, sftp, ssh, telnet, wget.
firstCommandWord extracts the command name, skipping leading VAR=value environment assignments.
extractRedirectionTargets parses shell redirection targets and extractAbsolutePathTokens collects absolute path tokens from the command.
Exports async evaluateShellCommandPolicy returning an allow/deny result for a Bash command.
Shell policy denies a missing/empty command (missing-command) and denies when no project root is present (project-root-missing).
Shell timeout defaults to DEFAULT_BASH_TIMEOUT_MS; non-positive or non-integer timeouts are denied (invalid-timeout) and timeouts above MAX_BASH_TIMEOUT_MS are denied (timeout-too-large).
Shell policy denies dangerouslyDisableSandbox (sandbox-override) and run_in_background (background-command).
Shell policy denies network-capable command names, embedded http/ws/ftp URLs (network-url), and parent-directory traversal (path-traversal).
Shell policy denies absolute path tokens that resolve outside the project root (path-containment) or under the instruction root (instruction-root).
Redirection targets are each validated through evaluateToolPathPolicy and denied as redirection-path on failure.
When no timeout was requested, the policy returns updatedInput injecting timeout=DEFAULT_BASH_TIMEOUT_MS.
Exports TOOLKIT_STORAGE_KEY='chirality.toolkit.v1'.
Exports type ToolkitValues (model, tools, maxTurns, includeSubagentGovernance, contextSealed, pipelineRunApproved, approvalRef) and ToolkitPreset/ToolkitState types.
MAX_PRESET_COUNT caps stored toolkit presets at 25.
defaultToolkitValues and defaultToolkitState return empty/false defaults with no presets and no selection.
sanitizeToolkitValues coerces an unknown record into typed ToolkitValues, trimming strings and booleanizing flags.
sanitizePreset rejects entries lacking id or name and defaults createdAt/updatedAt; sanitizeToolkitState caps presets to MAX_PRESET_COUNT and clears a selectedPresetId that no longer exists.

buildHarnessOptsFromToolkit builds HarnessOpts from toolkit values, splitting tools on newlines/commas, parsing maxTurns, and including subagentGovernance only when enabled; returns undefined when no options set.
createToolkitPreset assigns id 'preset-<epochMs>-<rand>' with sanitized values; upsertToolkitPreset replaces by id and caps to MAX_PRESET_COUNT, newest first.
DEFAULT_SDK_PACKAGE_VERSION defaults to '0.3.150'.
Exports type TurnEngineProviderMode: 'stub' | 'anthropic' | 'agentSdk'.
Exports type RunningHarnessTurn with sessionId, an AsyncIterable<UIEvent> events stream, and a cancel() method.
Exports type TurnEngineDependencies injecting session/persona/attachment/agentSdk managers and optional overrides for provider mode, API-key check, env, sdk version, and option/governance resolvers.
parseTurnRequest validates the request body as an object, requires a non-empty sessionId and string message, and requires attachments to be a string array.
assertKnownAgentSdkTools throws INVALID_REQUEST (400) listing any unknown harness tools resolved from the requested tools.
Exports class TurnEngine which serializes turns per session via an activeSessionTurns set.
TurnEngine.runTurn resumes the session, and for anthropic/agentSdk provider modes throws MISSING_API_KEY (503) when no Anthropic API key is configured.
runTurn throws TURN_IN_PROGRESS (409) if a turn is already active for the session, and always releases the turn lock on error.
In agentSdk mode runTurn calls assertKnownAgentSdkTools before resolving attachments.
runTurn throws ATTACHMENT_FAILURE (400) when there is no text and no executable (file) attachment.
runTurn evaluates subagent governance and attaches delegatedSubagents to effective opts only when governance allows, else an empty list.
The returned turn's cancel() interrupts the agent SDK best-effort and always releases the turn lock.
hasAnthropicApiKeyConfigured is true if the UI key check passes or ANTHROPIC_API_KEY / CHIRALITY_ANTHROPIC_API_KEY is set.

streamTurn persists session:init metadata (engineSessionId, claudeSessionId, model, and sdkSessionId/sdkPackageVersion in agentSdk mode), and on error yields turn:error then process:exit (exitCode 1).
classifyStreamErrorSeverity returns 'error' for status >= 500 and 'warning' otherwise.
buildAttachmentWarningText summarizes up to MAX_ATTACHMENT_WARNING_DETAILS (3) rejected attachments with an omitted-count line for the remainder.

Exports type HarnessErrorType union of error codes including INVALID_REQUEST, TURN_IN_PROGRESS, MISSING_API_KEY, SESSION_NOT_FOUND, SDK_FAILURE, WORKING_ROOT_INACCESSIBLE/CONFLICT, ATTACHMENT_FAILURE.
Exports interface SessionRecord with sessionId, projectRoot, persona, mode, timestamps, and optional SDK/engine session linkage fields.
Exports type CoordinationMode: 'SCHEDULE_FIRST' | 'DEPENDENCY_TRACKED' | 'HYBRID'.
Exports scaffold request/response interfaces including ScaffoldExecutionRootResponse with layoutValidation and preparationCompatibility.
Exports interface HarnessOpts with optional model, tools, maxTurns, persona, mode, subagentGovernance.
Exports interface ResolvedOpts with required model, tools, maxTurns, persona, mode plus optional subagentGovernance and delegatedSubagents.
Exports type ContentBlock as a union of {type:'text',text} and {type:'file',path,mimeType}.
Exports type UIEvent union: session:init, chat:delta, chat:complete, tool:result, session:complete, turn:error, process:exit.
Exports interface ISessionManager (create/resume/getById/save/list/delete) defining the session store contract.
Exports interface IPersonaManager (buildSystemPrompt, getBootFingerprint) and IAttachmentResolver (resolveAttachmentsToContentBlocks).
Exports interface IAgentSdkManager with startTurn (AsyncIterable<UIEvent>) and interrupt(sessionId).
Exports SUPPORTED_ATTACHMENT_EXTENSIONS: .png, .jpg, .jpeg, .gif, .webp, .pdf, .txt, .md, .csv.
MIME_BY_EXTENSION maps each supported extension to its MIME type (e.g. .png->image/png, .pdf->application/pdf, .md->text/markdown).
Exports type UiAttachment with path, displayName, mimeType, clientType.
attachmentFileName returns the last path segment and attachmentExtension returns the lowercased final dot-extension (empty when none).
resolveClientType maps image extensions to 'image', .pdf->'pdf', .md->'markdown', .csv->'csv', .txt->'text', else 'unknown'.
isSupportedAttachmentPath returns true when the extension is in the supported set; buildUiAttachment defaults unknown MIME to application/octet-stream.
sanitizeStoredAttachments dedups by path, skips entries without a path, and fills missing displayName/mimeType/clientType from buildUiAttachment fallbacks.
Exports LIFECYCLE_STATES tuple: OPEN, INITIALIZED, SEMANTIC_READY, IN_PROGRESS, CHECKING, ISSUED.
Exports type LifecycleState as the union of LIFECYCLE_STATES values.
Exports interface StatusHistoryEntry (date, state, actor, source 'list'|'table', optional fromState/notes, raw) and ParsedStatusDocument (title, currentState, lastUpdated, history, extraFields).
Exports StatusParseErrorCode (INVALID_STATUS_FORMAT, INVALID_STATE, INVALID_DATE) and class StatusParseError extending Error with code and details.
assertIsoDate enforces YYYY-MM-DD format, throwing INVALID_DATE otherwise.
Exports parseLifecycleState which uppercases and validates a state against LIFECYCLE_STATES, throwing INVALID_STATE for unknown values.
parseListHistory matches '- <date> - State set to <STATE> (<actor>) [notes]' list entries into StatusHistoryEntry rows with source 'list'.
parseTableHistory parses a Markdown table (>=5 cells) of date/fromState/toState/actor/notes, skipping header and separator rows, into source 'table' entries.
getHistoryLines extracts lines between the '## History' heading and the next '##' heading, throwing INVALID_STATUS_FORMAT when no History section exists.
parseHistory prefers list-format history entries and falls back to table-format entries, returning empty when neither matches.
parseExtraFields collects '**Key:** value' fields except 'current state' and 'last updated'.
Exports parseStatusDocument which extracts the title, Current State, and Last Updated fields, validates them, and assembles a ParsedStatusDocument with history and extra fields.
Import block in sdk-message-mapper.ts referencing SDK message types and local harness modules.
readTextFromContentBlock returns the text of a 'text' content block or undefined; isRecord/readString are local type-narrowing helpers.
